definitions.explanation: a traditional Japanese celebration held on the seventh night after a baby's birth, when the baby's name is formally announced

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{七夜|しちや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祝|いわ}った→祝う：01881_iwau⟧。
examples.english: We celebrated the baby's seventh-night ceremony.

examples.japanese: お{七夜|しちや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{命名書|めいめいしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: On the seventh night, they write out and display the naming certificate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{七夜|しちや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{済|す}ませる→済む：01950_sumu⟧⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{命名|めいめい}→命名：12030_meimei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{祝|いわ}い→お祝い：01339_oiwai⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にしたい。
examples.english: These days many families keep the seventh-night celebration simple, but they still want to make the naming ceremony special.

notes:
A traditional Japanese ceremony held on the seventh night after a baby's birth. The main purpose is the formal naming of the child. The baby's name is written on a {命名書|めいめいしょ} (naming certificate) and displayed in the home.

CEREMONY CUSTOMS:
- {命名書|めいめいしょ} — a calligraphied card or paper announcing the baby's name, displayed on the wall or at the family altar
- ⟦{祝|いわ}い{膳|ぜん}→祝い膳：30196_iwaizen⟧ — a celebratory meal, traditionally including {尾頭付|おかしらつ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鯛|たい}→鯛：14709_tai⟧ (whole sea bream) and ⟦{赤飯|せきはん}→赤飯：18955_sekihan⟧ (red bean rice)
- Family members and close relatives gather to meet the baby

RELATED CELEBRATIONS:
- {宮参|みやまい}り / ⟦お{宮参|みやまい}り→お宮参り：05925_omiyamairi⟧ — first shrine visit (around 30 days after birth)
- ⟦{百日祝|ももかいわ}い→百日祝い：24843_momokaiwai⟧ / ⟦お{食|く}い{初|ぞ}め→お食い初め：24466_okuizome⟧ — 100-day celebration with symbolic first meal
- ⟦{初節句|はつぜっく}→初節句：05922_hatsuzekku⟧ — first seasonal festival after birth

USAGE:
Also written without the honorific お as {七夜|しちや}, but the お{七夜|しちや} form is far more common.
